_comment: Single source of truth for container images. Must match infra_robot_sim config/images.json and the container_registry field of the Terraform SSM contract.

resume-smoke.note: Same image as robot-sim-worker; name kept for infra's recovery test, which runs the default smoke-resume experiment.

robot-controller.note: Built from infra_robot_sim platform/control until the controller migration lands.

robot-sim-isaaclab.note: Isaac Sim 5.1.0 + Isaac Lab v2.3.2 training image; built by build-isaaclab.yml.

robot-ros2.note: ROS 2 Jazzy + ur_robot_driver + policy node, for the lab PC; built by ros2.yml.
